name: federation-course
description: Starts Kafka, the other teams' APIs, the Claims Desk, and the gateway.

scripts.start: docker compose up -d --build --wait && npm --prefix gateway start
scripts.billing:ship-v2: echo BILLING_VERSION=2 > .env && docker compose up -d --wait billing
scripts.claim-events: docker compose exec kafka sh -c 'for p in 0 1 2; do echo "partition $p:"; /opt/kafka/bin/kafka-console-consumer.sh --bootstrap-server kafka:9092 --topic claim-events --partition $p --offset earliest --timeout-ms 2000 --formatter-property print.key=true --formatter-property key.separator=" " 2>/dev/null; done'
